easier.label: Make it easier
easier.hint: About 10% lighter, or an easier variation.

harder.label: Make it a bit harder
harder.hint: Small step up on load or reps.

min20.label: I only have 20 minutes
min20.hint: Keeps the main work, trims the extras.

tired.label: I'm feeling tired
tired.hint: Fewer sets, lighter loads, longer rests.

session.title: Workout
session.notFoundBody: It may have been replaced when your plan was updated.
session.extraNote: Extra sessions earn reduced XP and don't count toward your streak. Rest days are what make training work.
session.restWarning: You already trained today. A second hard session is rarely better than rest. Consider keeping this for another day.

skipped.recovery: Skipped for recovery. This keeps your streak safe.
skipped.unwell: Skipped while unwell. Your streak is safe. Come back when you feel ready.
skipped.busy: Skipped because of a busy day.

session.alreadyActive: Another workout is in progress. Finish or end it first.
session.adjustLead: Changes apply to this planned session. You can still adjust during the workout.
session.moveLead: Pick a day. Days that already have a workout are unavailable.
session.skipLead: Tell us why so your plan and streak stay fair.

recovery.label: I need recovery
recovery.hint: Sore or tired. Counts as neutral for your streak.

unwell.label: I'm unwell or hurt
unwell.hint: Take care of yourself. Streak is safe.

busy.label: Too busy
busy.hint: Ends the current streak, but you can restart anytime.

skipToast.recovery: Recovery day taken. Streak is safe.

session.replaceLead: Swap {name} for something that fits your equipment and limits.
session.noAlternativesBody: Nothing else fits your equipment and limitations for this muscle group.
